title: Export shows Not Tracked for an untracked part and has no status column
custom_preconds:
Setup (manual QA tester and Claude session)

Preconditions

  • You are signed in as an Admin at {Location-A} (for example Staging Heavy Duty - 9919). The Admin role has 'Part Library & Inventory → View / Create & Edit / Delete'.
  • Inventory part {Part-A} (for example ZZAUTOTEST-PL-EXPNT-01) is active and tracked at {Location-A}, with quantity 6 in its default bin.
  • Inventory part {Part-B} (for example ZZAUTOTEST-PL-EXPNT-02) is active and untracked, with quantity 4 in its bin.
  • Both part numbers start with {Prefix-A} (for example ZZAUTOTEST-PL-EXPNT).
custom_steps:
1. In the top bar click Parts, then click Inventory in the left menu.
  2. Type {Prefix-A} in the Search box.
  3. Click the ⋮ actions menu button in the toolbar, to the left of New Inventory Part.
  4. Click Export.
  5. Open the downloaded file and find the rows for {Part-A} and {Part-B}.
  6. Read every column heading in the file.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 5: In the quantity column the {Part-B} row reads "Not Tracked" and the {Part-A} row reads 6.
  • Step 6: No column holds the part's status: there is no Status, Active or Inactive column.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-10647; story SV-10814 (Story 1, Active and Inactive Tabs on the Inventory List); PRD "Parts Lifecycle Update", Confluence 829227015, v29 (14 Oct 2026 copy), S1-R9a, S4-R8, read 14 Oct 2026; design canvas board 5.3 (The list says Not Tracked), 13 Oct copy. Source-verified 14 October 2026; not yet build-verified (no Part Lifecycle QA build exists).

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S1-R9a: “An untracked part exports "Not Tracked" in the quantity column. The export has no status column.”
  • S4-R8: “An untracked part shows "Not Tracked" in the Inventory list's Total Qty column instead of a quantity.”
